description: Defines the template class TiffEntryImpl for handling TIFF entry data, including methods for writing data and tag info, and managing internal data structures related to TIFF entries.

classes.name: TiffEntryImpl
classes.description: Template class implementing TIFF entry handling, including data writing, size calculation, and data access.

methods.name: TiffEntryImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing TIFF entry with tag, type, count, endianness, and data.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of data elements.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the TIFF entry.

methods.name: getDataHelper
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internal data array.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the size of the data in bytes, aligned.

methods.name: getActualSize
methods.description: Calculates the actual size of the data in bytes, considering special types.

methods.name: getEndianness
methods.description: Returns the endianness of the data.

methods.name: getComparableValue
methods.description: Returns a value suitable for comparison, based on the tag.

methods.name: writeTagInfo
methods.description: Writes the TIFF tag information to an output stream.

methods.name: writeData
methods.description: Writes the data to an output stream, handling endianness and alignment.
